**Review of the landing hero draft**

- **"Subscribers can pause or cancel any time"** is on the claims allowlist, so it's fine.
- **"free UK delivery on orders over £25"** is also on the allowlist and is worded correctly, with the threshold stated.
- **"means most boxes ship free"** is the problem. The policy backs only the £25 threshold. It says nothing about what share of orders clears it, so "most boxes ship free" is an unsupported claim about order values and reads as a statistic we can't verify. It also says "boxes" when the policy describes tins and tea bags. Cut the phrase, or end the sentence after "over £25".

Suggested fix: "Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25."
